qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Statutory network monopoly over ~38,000 km of Italian gas transmission pipelines, 17 Bcm of storage capacity, and LNG terminals, with ARERA inflation-indexed RAB returns.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (REJECT). Italian gas transmission monopoly carries €14.4B debt (net debt ~€19B in 2025/2026) vs €1.24B net income (11.6x debt/NI), thin 4.6x interest coverage, and capped 7.6% ROIC with annual capex (€2.7B) exceeding D&A (€1.0B) by nearly 3x.
qualitative.evidence: 4-year median GAAP ROIC is 7.57% (FY22: 4.57%, FY23: 7.74%, FY24: 7.95%, FY25: 7.39%), capped by ARERA regulatory parameters. Long-term debt of €14.37B and net debt of ~€19.0B severely exceed the 4.0x net debt/NI baseline (11.6x-15.4x). FY25 interest coverage is 4.58x (below the 5.0x minimum threshold), with ongoing capex of €2.7B requiring continuous debt issuance.
